text.p: Following are the main stories in today's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Malaysian schools are the biggest breeding grounds for the aedes mosquito that spreads dengue fever, Health Minister Chua Jui Meng said. About 32 people have been killed by dengue fever this year.
-- A proposed Consumers Protection Act may only offer limited cover because of lack of cooperation among a few ministries, Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs minister Megat junid Megat Ayob said.
-- Malaysian companies have been asked to diversify their currency risks and reduce exposure to European currencies ahead of the European Monetary Union in 1999.
